title: At-risk share of the 2024 loan cohort
prompt: Of loans originated in 2024, what fraction are still 'current' status but already have 2 or more late-or-missed payments — a leading risk indicator before default?
population: Loans originated in 2024, joined to their loan_payments.
metricDefinition: loans originated in 2024 with status = current AND ≥2 late/missed payments, divided by all loans originated in 2024.
transformationPlan: flag as at-risk if status is current and issue_count ≥ 2
compute the rate against all 2024-originated loans
referenceSql: WITH payment_issues AS (SELECT loan_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('late', 'missed')) AS issue_count FROM loan_payments GROUP BY loan_id) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'current' AND coalesce(pi.issue_count, 0) >= 2)::DOUBLE / count(*) AS at_risk_rate FROM loans l LEFT JOIN payment_issues pi ON pi.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE l.originated_at >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND l.originated_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
